column1: 5.5.4.2.9.10 Platform Type. When user clicks on this menu item a GUI, as shown in
Figure 5.73, shall be displayed. User shall check ‘Enable’ option, select required filter
parameter (Platform Type: Ship, Submarine, Aircraft, Missile etc.,) & and click on ‘Apply’
option to enforce this filter or shall click on ‘Disable’ option to remove this filter on SCD
